name: Math
summary: Game math in pure GBX: scalars, angles, vectors, rectangles, collision, random, noise and curves.
description: Everyday game math without C++ or archives. It provides clamping, interpolation and remapping, frame-rate independent damping, degree-based angle helpers with shortest-path turns, a VEC2 type with in-place methods, an axis-aligned RECT2 type, point/circle/rect/segment collision tests with per-axis penetration for platformers, random ranges and chances, deterministic value noise and fBm, Bezier and Catmull-Rom curves and spring steps. Everything runs unchanged in the interpreter, a built EXE and the HTML5 player.
author: GameBasiX
